notes.title: June 20th Patch
notes.notes:
Attack Drone Rework
The purpose of this change is to make the card more relevant. The card's purpose is to be a cheap way to defend against melee troops.


 Energy Cost decreased to 2 from 4.
 Card now only spawns 1 troop instead of 2.
 Health decreased to 50 from 90.
 Rate of fire increased.
 Range increased.


Quality of Life Improvements

 Trying to get into an occupied base now notifies the occupant.
 Immediate feedback is given when trying to hop out of the base.
 Added automatic error reporting when you launch the game if it had crashed previously.

notes.title: June 1st Patch
notes.notes:
Updates

 You can now use the 1234 keys to play cards in addition to WASD.
 A sound now plays when a match is found in online mode.

Balance Changes

 Towers now fire micro-missiles at Mechs that are nearby the base. This is to make it less effective to dive on the enemy base without having first destroyed their towers.
 Heavy Support Drone HP reduced to 400 from 450.
 Heavy Support Drone Timer reduced to 57 seconds from 75 seconds.
 Grenade Mech grenades now deal increased damage to Mechs.

notes.title: May 29th Patch
notes.notes:
Online Mode Updates

 The online mode is no longer a secret. I've posted about it on my socials: https://linktr.ee/sam_makes_games
 3v3, 2vai and 3vai added.
 You can now vote for your team's deck before a match begins.
 Stun state is now better synced between clients.
 Menus improved, to better fit online play.
 You can now no longer see your opponents' cards and energy bar during online play.


Online Mode Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where multiple mechs could get stuck in the command tank. 
 Fixed an issue where volt orbs would stick to enemy mechs.
 Melee attack hit detection improved. 
 Base no longer displays "1hp" after being destroyed.
 Fixed some issues that would cause an online lobby's data to be corrupted and never start a match.
 Matchmaking has had lots of fixes. Still has issues that will need fixing in the future after I've had more testing.


Misc.

 Fixed an issue where the lancer's lunge attack could prevent you from respawning.
 Improved menus to allow a match to be started with only the mouse.
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial's controls HUD would not appear.
 Mech aiming reticle now appears over jungle trees when using keyboard+mouse.
 Jungle trees have a simplified appearance when the vegetation setting is set to off. Improves performance.

notes.title: April 25th Patch
notes.notes:
Secret Mode Updates

 The online mode is still a secret between you and me.
 All maps are now playable in the online mode!
 All mechs are now playable in the online mode!
 All cards are now playable in the online mode!
 Online Matchmaking has been added! It's still very basic and only supports 1v1 and 2v2.


Misc. Updates

 More art added to campaign mode between battles.
 Fixed like 1000 online netcode bugs.

notes.title: April 4th Patch (The Secret Update)
notes.notes:
The Secret Update

 Shhhh. I've secretly been adding online multiplayer for the past few months.
 I haven't announced it yet, so don't tell anybody. 
 It's in an early state, but should work reasonably well already. 
Note: The following features have not yet been implemented in online mode:

 Revolver Mech
 Jungle Map
 Throwing the Ball-Bot
 Volt mech's bouncing orbs
 Leaving mid-match
 Automatic Matchmaking
 Campaign Mode



Miscellaneous Updates

 Fixed a rare bug where a boss could fail to spawn.
 Campaign mode environment art updated in between battles. Looks much nicer now.
 Health bar chunks now have a max width, so smaller enemies will now have smaller health bars.
 Hit flash looks different when at critically low HP. Corpses now flash when they appear.
 Some campaign mode supplies have been buffed. 
 New art for Power Shards and Enemy Intel.

notes.title: February 7th Patch
notes.notes:
Balance Updates

 Grenade Mech Debuff: Self-healing from heal grenades greatly reduced.
 Grenade Mech Debuff: Movement speed reduced to 2.6 from 3.
 Heavy Tank Debuff: Attack reduced to 200 from 220.
 Heavy Support Drone Buff: Health increased to 450 from 300.
Boulder damage increased to 350 from 200
 Boulders can now be rolled into Command Tanks (does reduced damage: 250 )
 Buildings must now be placed a minimum distance from one another.


Quality of Life Updates

Rescue zones now draw an arrow to nearby mechs.
 Sand pile collision improved.
 Cards played in invalid locations should now move units to valid locations more reliably.
 Key art updated!
 Lots of bugs fixed.


Bugs Fixed

 Fixed a crash that could occur when pausing the game in certain areas.
 Anti-Mech drones should get stuck less often.
 Getting stunned while throwing a ball-bot will no longer make the ball-bot disappear.
 AI Should place buildings on top of each other far less frequently.
 "Supply Chain Improvements" equipment fixed.

notes.title: January 8th Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Updates
Final Boss Update

 The 'Blitz Tank' is here, watch out for its massive drill!
 This is a large battle tank covered in a variety of turrets that pursues the player's command tank in a high speed chase.

Other Campaign Updates

 More Equipment for the shop.
 Difficulty scaling updated.


Quality of Life Updates

 Pause menu made navigable by mouse.
 Volume settings now accessible on the pause menu.
 Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Dec 6th Patch
notes.notes:
Visual Updates

 3d rotation effect added to cards in Campaign Mode.
 More unique icons added for tech cards.


other updates

 Mech Boost now maxes out after 30 energy spent.
 Scanning system updated, it now will be saved to your save file.
 Fixed lots of bugs.

notes.title: November 22nd Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Updates
Mech Boost

Mech Boosting is a new system to encourage the player to exit the command tank.
You build Mech Boost when you deploy troops, it is activated when you exit the tank.
A boosted Mech has increased speed, damage, reload speed, and cooldown speed for a limited time.
Tutorial screens added to explain mechanics for new players.


New Test Maps

A new small map and tiny map have been added.
These are to test the visuals with a zoomed in camera. If feedback is positive, I could create smaller versions of each map for more variety.


Misc Updates

 Dynamic cloud shadows added to every map.
 Mechs now leave footprints on the ground.
 New muzzle flash for mech attacks.
 Command Tanks now leave treadmarks on the ground.
 Explosions now leave soot marks on the ground.

notes.title: October 29th Patch
notes.notes:
Stability Updates

 Fixed a few bugs that could cause the game to crash. 


Other Updates

 A player who joins the game on the character select screen will now kick a bot out if no other slots are available.
 The HUD now displays player HP as a number in addition to their hp bar.
 The HUD has been updated to be more lore accurate.

notes.title: October 25th Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Updates
Meta-Progression

 You can now gain permanent upgrades for the roguelite campaign mode, called "supplies". 
 Supplies persist between runs, and are highly customizable!
 New Reward Type: Power Shards!
 Power Shards can be spent in between runs to purchase supplies!
 They can also be spent to upgrade your supply drone, allowing you to carry more supplies!
 New Reward Type:  Enemy Intel!
 Enemy Intel can be used to research new supplies in between runs!
 Both new reward types are persistent. They are not lost between runs.


Other Updates

 Dialogue added to explain supplies.
 Various Bug Fixes
 Convention Mode added back oops

notes.title: September 25th Patch
notes.notes:
New Unit!
Heavy Support Drone

 Can be deployed anywhere on the map, like an ability.
 Remains stationary when deployed, and decays over time.
 Heals friendlies at 90 hp / second
 The 'Missile Barrage' ability fires 10 micro missiles at nearby enemies.


Misc. Updates

 Shop Items now have a 10% chance to go on sale for 30% off.
 Added damage scrap for 5 units that were missing it
 AI Commander targeting updated for certain cards
 Added sound effects to Medic Drone
 Lots of bugs fixed

notes.title: September 4th "DreamHack" Patch
notes.notes:
DreamHack 2024 Update
This update brings a few changes made for October's DreamHack gaming convention. 

 The game now goes into an "attract mode" if no controller input is detected for 30 seconds.
 Difficulty tweaks.
 Battle Mode will now display a few tooltips to help new players.
 The game's loading screen now says "wishlist mech tech" hehe



Miscellaneous Updates 

 Lots of UI tweaks and improvements. 
 Lots of bugfixes for reserves slots and dragging cards.
 Fixed a typo that slowed down the main menu WOOPS
 Lots of bugfixes

notes.title: August 22nd Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Updates

New Mechanic! Reserves Deck
 You now have a reserves deck where you can store cards. You can grow the size of your reserves deck by collecting slots during a run.
 Your reserves are split into two categories, Vanguard and Rear Guard
 Vanguard cards are deployed (for free) when you destroy an enemy tower.
 Rear Guard cards are deployed (for free) when one of your towers is destroyed.
 You can now drag cards to move them between your main deck and reserves deck.


Misc. Updates

 When using the mouse+keyboard, your bullets will now shoot towards your cursor, even when you are not holding the aim button.
 Visuals updated on dialog box.
 Tutorial updated to correctly show playstation prompts
 Lots of bug fixes

notes.title: July 31st Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Updates

 You can now drag equipment to swap it between different cards! (this took more work than you'd expect)
 More dynamic dialog! Now you should see NO repeated dialog for at least your first 5 runs. 
 Coop mode renamed to "Campaign Mode" since it can be played single player.


Quality of Life Updates

 Level geometry updated to help prevent units getting stuck near chokepoints.
 Lots of bug fixes

notes.title: July 24th Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Updates

 Supply Drone art updated. This drone will deliver your permanent roguelite upgrades at the start of each run. (in a future update)
 Procedural generation tweaked in a few ways to reduce player frustration early in the run.
 Game over screen updated to show some stats from run, and party members being captured. More stats to come soon.


Quality of Life Updates

 Screenshake can now be disabled in the settings menu
 Vibration can now be disabled in the settings menu
 Various UI updates based on player feedback
 Lots of small bugfixes

notes.title: July 16th Patch
notes.notes:
Character Reworks
Autocannon Mech

 Autocannon now has Micro-Missiles ability. This fires 4 missiles at nearby enemies.
 Autocannon no longer has a second item slot.
 Autocannon no longer has a second dash charge.
 Autocannon can now dummy fire with the fire button.


MKI Mech

 MKI now has Mini Mines ability. This throws 4 mini mines in front of the player.
 MKI no longer has the Missile Request ability.


Coop Updates

 The party members now march with the command tank between missions.
 The mech select button now flashes when a new choice is available.
 The starting deck now contains an infantry.

notes.title: July 9th Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Updates

 1 New Equipment: Spinning Orbs
 Enemy deck procedural generation updated to reduce difficulty in the first few matches.
 Enemy energy regen speed increases at a slower rate over the course of a run.
 The command tank now restores 200 hp between rounds. And 400 hp after bosses.
 Bosses made slightly easier.


Doomba Overhaul

 Doomba's ability changed to 'SUPER SUCK'.
 This greatly increases suction power for 2 seconds.
 The self destruct ability will now be automatically activated upon death, if 10 enemies are inside the doomba.
Movement speed decreased to 0.9 from 1.


Quality of Life Updates

 Player indicator is now shown on the Command Tank
 Card Tip buttons in coop now display all card info.
 Tutorial updated to better explain item usage and command tank play.
The Mech Select button in coop now flashes when new mechs are available.
 Random Tank numbers can no longer be the naughty number.
 Dialog box now smoothly moves onto the screen.
 'Targeting Laser' ability renamed to 'Missile Request'
 Fixed lots of bugs

notes.title: June 25th Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Updates

 Dialogue progress is now saved in the save file.
 New dialog added.
 Most conversations will now not repeat, and will progress over multiple runs. This is still an early work in progress.
 A tiny "scene" plays at the end of bosses.
 The advisor will now give you  a few tips for your first run or two.


 Quality Of Life Updates

 Player Indicators have been overhauled and now permanently float above players.
 The energy bar now flashes when you have 10 energy.
 You can now hop out, even when your cursor is too far away from the base.
 Pressing the battle mode button now auto-joins the player who pressed the button, and adds a bot if that is the only connected gamepad.
 Small secret update to help new players hehehe
 Lots of smaller QoL updates and bugs fixed

notes.title: June 21st Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Updates

 New Boss moves made easier. (they were too hard)
 Updated difficulty scaling to make the game more difficult in the later half of the run.
 The Mech Select button now displays icons for the available mechs.
 Fanfare added when a mech pilot joins your party.
 New Art for equipment items!
 Cleaned up some visuals during boss battles.



Other Updates
[olist]
 Added a 'Wishlist' button on the main menu.
 Fixed some bugs.
[/olist]

notes.title: June 19th Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Mode Updates

 You can now save your progress during coop mode! (likely still buggy)
 2 NEW Boss Moves added!
 8 NEW Equipment added to the shop!
 1 NEW Tech Upgrade added!


Other Updates

 Various bug fixes

notes.title: June 13th Patch
notes.notes:
Battle Mode Updates

 There is now a "building lifespan" match setting.
 There is now a " 3 2 1 GO!" sequence at the start of battles!
 There is now a "GAME!" sequence at the end of battles!
 The Doomba now makes vacuum sounds ːsteammockingː
 The Rescue Jet now makes jet engine sounds
 Fixed some bugs


Vibrations Disabled Temporarily

 Due to an issue with an extension, controller vibrations are temporarily disabled. They will return new and improved soon.

notes.title: May 28th HotFix
notes.notes: Fixes an issue with Playstation controllers not working on certain menus. (I hope)

notes.title: May 28th Patch
notes.notes:
Input Updates

 Mech Tech now allows for 8 Xbox Controllers to be used!
 The game now utilizes Open XInput. Made possible by the GameMaker Extension made by Andrew Henley.


Note: This is still in testing. You may experience controller input bugs. Please submit a bug report if this occurs.

notes.title: May 23rd Patch
notes.notes:
Balance Changes
Rocket Trooper Rework

 This is now an Anti-Mech unit. It prioritizes targeting mechs.
 Only one Rocket Trooper is spawned when the card is played.
 Now a special range boost is applied when targeting a mech. (+120 Range)
 Rocket projectile changed to Seeker Missile.
 Range increased to 150 from 100.
 Attack increased to 60 from 30.
 Rate of fire slightly increased.


Infantry Changes

 Damage reduced to 20 from 25
 Rate of fire slightly increased to keep DPS the same as before.
 This makes infantry slightly better against groups.


Doomba Changes

 Doomba now stuns enemies inside when it is destroyed.
 If the Doomba self-destructs, this stun effect is greatly increased and applies to enemies nearby the Doomba.
 This stun scales with the number of units inside the Doomba.
 Explosion visuals updated to show the effect radius.


Coop Updates

 New Conversation and Tip buttons added. (50 conversations so far!)
 You can now ZOOM when viewing card details. (right click, or right trigger)


Misc Updates

 You now have to release the interact button inside the Command Tank before you can exit. This will fix the issue where you could enter and immediately exit the Command Tank by holding down the button for too long.
 Added a "Hop out for ally" message when a friendly mech is near your base and low HP.
 Added a "Too far from base" message when players try to spawn units on the opponent's side of the field.
 Fixed a good amount of bugs.

notes.title: May 17th hotfix
notes.notes: Fixes slowdown issue on main menu

notes.title: May 16th Patch
notes.notes:
Volt Mech Rework

 The volt mech's heat management system has been reworked into the less punishing "power" system.
 Shots now consume power, instead of generating heat.
 When power reaches zero, you can still fire shots, but they will have significantly less damage and range.


Other Changes

 You can now re-roll shop items, for a cost.
 Fixed issue where some ability equipment didn't work.
 Various small bug fixes and tutorial polish

notes.title: May 14th Patch
notes.notes:
Tutorial Updated
[olist]
 The tutorial now teaches how to hop in and out of the base. And why you want to do that.
 Various small bugs in the tutorial have now been fixed
[/olist]

 Other Updates

 Autocannon Mech aim has been improved slightly, allowing firing of targets barely touching your aim cone.
 Tech and Equipment descriptions have been updated to be easier to read.
 Some equipment has been rebalanced.
 Screenshake has been updated slightly
 Quitting out now asks for confirmation to avoid accidental presses.

notes.title: May 7th Patch
notes.notes:
Updates

 5 new equipment added to shop in coop mode
 You can now spend money to repair your base in coop mode


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where cursors would be locked into a small portion of the screen when playing on monitors with a resolution below 1080p

notes.title: May 4th Patch
notes.notes:
Balance Updates

 Bosses made a little bit easier.
 Aura Equipment now activates more frequently
 Rare tech and equipment are more likely to appear later into a run


Bug Fixes

 Volt mech can now use Mag Release System tech.
 Speed tech now works as intended. (rounding removed)
 Fixed bug where equipment would attach to wrong card
 Fixed tech detail boxes
 Fixed bug where rider mines would lose equipment after riding
 Fixed multiple visual bugs related to boss battles and UI
 Desert map geometry updated to prevent units from occasionally getting stuck on walls

notes.title: April 29th Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Mode Updates

Shops Added!!
Equipment is a new type of upgrade that can be bought in shops. 
[olist]
 You now earn money after every battle.
Equipment can now be bought and attached to your cards.
[/olist]

Other Coop Updates

 Added more Mech Tech Upgrades.
 The UI for choosing your path has been updated to show more info
 Enemies will now also have Tech and Equipment
 ♫ New Music for the shop ♫
 Various menu updates
 Note: equipment art is placeholder


Other Updates
[olist]
New art for Crossing and Mountain maps
 Lots of bug fixes
[/olist]

notes.title: March 17th Patch
notes.notes:
Coop Mode Updates

 Added two new Green Tech Upgrades


 Map Updates

 Mountain map updated to make bottom lane bigger, and have improved visuals.
 Crossing map updated with more grass layers.


Other Updates
[olist]
 Added a 'cancel' button to prevent playing unwanted cards.
 Controls are now viewable from the pause menu.
 Fixed some bugs.
[/olist]

notes.title: February 11th Patch
notes.notes:
Changes

 New Art for the Auto-Cannon Mech!!!!
 Fixed a game crashing bug related to mech AI

notes.title: February 10th Patch
notes.notes:
Demo Version

 The playtest is now the DEMO version for testing purposes. This means some content will be locked. The playtest version will have all content unlocked again in a future patch.

Updates and Fixes

 New Character art on Mech Screen and Victory Screen!
 New Boss Theme for Boss Battles!
 Updated Boss Visuals
 Improved area transitions in the coop mode
 The tutorial is now recommended to first time players
 Various small bug fixes

notes.title: January 28th Patch
notes.notes:
Various Small Fixes/Changes

 Campaign deck now starts with a Brawler.
 Fixes for bugs that could crash the game.
 Heavy Type icon changed to shield from weight for clarity.
 Upgrades vs new tech made more visually distinct.
 Fixed new issue with light tank and heavy tank range.
 Pre-boss dialog updated to remove confusion.
 Added recoil animation to light tank and heavy tank.


Credits added to main menu

notes.title: January 23rd Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Updates

Added dialog at the start of boss stages.
Added more distinct visual effects to hijacked mechs.
Boss hp now scales with player count.
Bosses will no longer use the same move twice in a row.
Bosses now receive reduced stun durations.
 Fixed a bug where the Base Tank health could be overwritten in coop mode.
Bases now display their hp in text on top of their health bars.
Various fixes to UI

notes.title: January 18th Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Mode Updates

 Tech Upgrades added! A Tech upgrade can be chosen after every match.
 Bosses updated with new health bar and dialog.

notes.title: January 4th Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Mode Updates
MKI Mech Added

 This is the starting mech, and is less powerful than the other mechs.
 The Burst Rifle fires in 3 round bursts, with a 9 round magazine.
  The Targeting Laser ability fires a seeker missile from the base towards the designated target.


Bosses Added

 The other mechs will join your party if you defeat them in a Boss Battle!
 Each boss has unique moves, and more will be added in future updates.
 If a boss depletes your health bar, he will throw your disabled mech at your own base, dealing a large amount of damage.


Misc. Campaign Updates

 Enemy decks will now contain dud cards for the first few matches.
 Enemy MKI Mechs will now appear.
 UI updates and dialogue added to help new players.
 Various changes to balance, and procedural generation.


AI Improvements

 AI Mechs will now return to their base to heal if they are damaged. This will happen more frequently if the mech is a higher level.


Menu Overhaul

 Main menu updated to be way more stylish and user friendly.
 Splash screen added with key art.


Misc. Updates

 Battle mode and 8 player mode options separated on the main menu, to lead single players toward a better experience.
 Lots of bugfixes.
 Various small UI updates to help new players.
 Tutorial updated to explain bonus energy.
 Tutorial updated to be easier.

notes.title: September 23rd Patch
notes.notes:
Campaign Mode Added!!

 This is an early version, most planned features are not yet present.
 This mode is meant for 1 to 4 players. 
 This has taken a lot of work so far, and has not yet been playtested. So any feedback would be appreciated! ːsteamhappyː


Revolver Mech Rework

 The revolver mech's ability has been simplified for ease of use. "Chamber Spin" is now "Special Reload".
 Shooting enemies builds combo. When you reload, your combos are now stored.
 Up to 5 combos can be stored.
 Double tap reload to "Special Reload". This will spend your stored combos to load more powerful bullets.
 This special reload will happen automatically if you store 5 combos.
 View the tips on the Mech-Select screen to learn more. (Press Y/Triangle/W to flip to the tips page)


Other Changes

 New art for the Desert map! 
 Player portraits now shake when damaged.
 Tips added to the Mech-Select screen. (Press Y/Triangle/W to flip to the tips page)
 UI during mech gameplay updated for readability.
 New animation on VS Screen
 Corpse added for Microbots
 Lots and lots of bugfixes

notes.title: June 27th Patch
notes.notes:
Changes

 Mortar Barrage has become Scatter Shot. The ability functions the same, but looks way cooler.
 New art for Precision Missile card.
 New art for Healing Missile card.
 New VS Screen art
 The Mountain stage now has boulders spawn in the top lane. Push these downhill to crush enemies.
 Cool new animated logo on title screen.
 Leaping out of the Command Tank now takes less time if you are landing nearby.
 Light Tank HP Reduced to 550 from 600
 Light Tank Artillery shell travel time reduced
 Changed the initially unlocked cards to the standard deck
 Challenge Mode will now be locked until after VS Mode has been played
 Awesome new Key Art for the store page


Bug Fixes

 Mountain map top lane made 1 tile more wide to allow more room for the boulders.
 Fixed multiple issues regarding the player number indicators.
 Fixed issue where the ending to the Launch Map music would play prematurely
 Fixed issues with the shadows of flying units
 Fixed issues with the "invalid location" visuals for playing cards.
 Fixed issue where Lancer would ignore stun while dashing.
 A whole bunch more that I didn't write down

notes.title: April 25th patch
notes.notes:
Changes
 Attempting to play cards in an invalid location will play them in a nearby valid location. You can see where the card will be played by holding the button and moving your cursor into an invalid location.
 Attempting to exit the base in an invalid location will instead make your mech hop to a nearby valid location. You can see where you will exit by holding the exit button and moving your cursor into an invalid location.
 The main and pause menus are now navigable via d-pad.
 Dashing now reduces the Revolver Mech's bloom to 0.
 The HUD now displays if a mech is in the command tank or inside of a Doomba.
 The Bonus Energy mechanic is now explained in the tutorial.
 All buildings and vehicles now explode into little pieces when destroyed.
 Cards are now sorted by type on the deck building screen.

 Bug Fixes
 Grenades no longer collide with vegetation
 Grenades now correctly collide with the Command Tank
 Fixed the layering on the Jungle Trees
 Unlocking a mech now displays the new art.
 Fixed the hitboxes on the spear and stun spear

notes.title: March 26th Patch
notes.notes:
Added the ability to start a match with only bots
 New art for Shock Trooper
 UI Improvements to Deck Building screen
 UI Improvements to Mech Select screen
 Added option to disable X-Input or D-Input APIs on main menu. (This only affects adding and removing controllers on the mech select screen)
 various bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: March 11th Patch
notes.notes:
New art for melee weapons 
 All new UI art during battles
 All new UI art on Mech Select Screen
 New UI art on Deck Building screen

notes.title: March 6th patch
notes.notes:
Lock mouse within the active application.
 Added Dash-Strike ability for Lancer.

notes.title: March 3rd patch
notes.notes:
Fixed camera issue that skipped a large portion of the tutorial. 
Added new art for the Lancer unit.
Fixed tile issue on Jungle Map.
